fact: In the DGI's Impôt-Com no. 38 (August 2025) the Director General states E-Impôt has been in production since January 2019 and large-enterprise (DGE) and medium-enterprise (CIME) taxpayers file returns electronically.
title: Direction générale des Impôts (DGI) : Les avantages de la digitalisation des procédures administratives
